final: WITH rates AS (SELECT m.Name AS media_type_name, 1.0 * SUM(t.Bytes) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), scored AS (SELECT media_type_name, rate, track_count, AVG(rate) OVER () AS mean_rate FROM rates) SELECT media_type_name, rate, track_count, rate - mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean FROM scored WHERE rate > mean_rate
